episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Nak Soo casts one last spell to save her soul. Jang Wook looks for the only sorcerer who would dare to help him. Moo Duk gets taken under a new master.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: When Moo Duk refuses Wook's proposal to form an alliance, he convinces her in other ways. Park Jin barricades Songrim to catch a spy.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Moo Duk sets the terms before beginning proper training. Wook discovers that Heo Yum left him with a gift he must learn to claim as his own.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Wook suffers a fever and chills, much to Moo Duk's delight. The Crown Prince visits the Jang household, demanding a family heirloom and a show of respect.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Moo Duk and Wook arrive at a secluded, empty cabin. Jin Moo orders a body dump. Jin Ho Kyung offers protection for Wook... at a cost.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Seo Yul and Park Dang Goo visit Wook at his training ground. Moo Duk pushes her student to the extreme. Jin Cho Yun prepares a wedding gift.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The Prince encounters an illusion. Wook demands entry into Jinyowon. Gil Joo goes after Nak Soo to acquire a body.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Gil Joo stumbles into town to satisfy his hunger. Wook follows closely behind him. Rumors surface of Nak Soo's comeback.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Jin Ho Kyung looks for her long-lost child. Jin Moo devises a plan to help end that search. Wook and Moo Duk are driven apart.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Wook is given a book to read. Yul saves a girl at the market. Moo Duk goes through an intensive selection process to become a servant at Songrim.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Wook loses the will to train. Moo Duk makes a bet with the Prince. At Cheonbugwan, a line of blind girls await judgment.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: An unusual death draws Park Jin's attention. Wook learns of Naksu's tragic past. Maid Kim sends Moo Duk on an errand to Cheonbugwan.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: A sudden lightning strike causes damage to Cheonbugwan. Park Jin and Jin Mu dispute who's to blame. Master Lee takes Uk on a special fishing trip.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Wook faces his tenth and final opponent with a trick or two up his sleeve. Seo Yul keeps Moo Duk close. Jin Woo Tak plays a trick on his daughter.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Moo Duk is caught at the site of a bloody murder. Master Lee presents the royal family with a gift and a prophecy. So I tracks down a blind friend.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Park Jin and Jin Ho Kyung get into a heated dispute as they both lay claim to an artifact. Wook runs into the Prince while on the search for a shaman.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.summary: Moo Duk investigates Jin Bu Yun's true identity. Jin Mu convinces Jin Ho Kyung to make a special announcement at an important assembly.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.summary: Trapped inside an enchanted force field, Moo Duk explores her newfound powers but soon learns of its drawbacks. So I makes a deal with a soul shifter.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.summary: It is revealed to all the world that the queen's identity was the family of Dangol's Choi. Wook puts all of her own skills in a dangerous attempt to break the barrier of her ice stone. And then, Jang Gang, the beginning of everything, appears in the pine forest...

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.summary: Love is in the air with a wedding on the way and Wook playing matchmaker. Jin Mu appoints an assassin to do his dirty work and become his scapegoat.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A search leads Wook into Jinyowon, where he runs into a mysterious woman who is planning an escape. Meanwhile, haunting visions of the dead trouble him.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Jin Ho Kyung makes a family secret public. Jin Bu Yun finds new shelter but realizes that her freedom is limited and time is running out.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A debate surrounding a secret wedding ends with a shocking announcement. Jin Ho Kyug tries to summon Bu Yun back by causing her excruciating pain.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Flashes of another's memory leads Bu Yun to find out more about Wook's past heartbreak. News of a feared assassin's return shakes the whole kingdom.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Yul uncovers the mystery of his ill health as So I becomes desperate to save him. Wook and Bu Yun continue to hit barriers in their relationship.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: While Yul bears the burden of a heavy secret, Wook investigates a conspiracy involving a mysterious animal that could cause a devastating drought.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: To save a fatally injured mage, Wook gives Jin Mu a firm warning and asks Jin Ho Kyung for help, who agrees to cooperate under one condition.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Go Won presents Wook with a choice. Jin Mu sets the next step of his plan in motion. Heo Yun Ok requests to meet Bu Yun in private.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: As the search for the ice stone continues, Wook reaffirms his alliances while Jin Mu prepares for battle with an army of loyal soul shifters.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Jin Ho Kyung takes a risk to protect Jinyowon and its treasures from attack. Having had a glimpse into the future, Wook braces for the inevitable.
